tables.title: Pooled Effect
notes: τ² estimated by restricted maximum likelihood.

assumptions.message: With fewer than 10 studies the test has little power; do not read a non-significant result as absence of bias.

interpretation.text: A random-effects meta-analysis of 9 studies gave a pooled mean difference of −15.11, 95% CI [−32.64, 2.43], z = −1.69, p = .091. Heterogeneity was considerable (I² = 99.0%, Q(8) = 238.92, p < .001). The prediction interval for a new study is [−69.30, 39.09].

title: Meta-Analysis (Continuous Outcomes)
code:
library(ggnext)
# Random-effects meta-analysis (mean difference)
d <- data[complete.cases(data[, c("study", "n_stroke_unit", "mean_stroke_unit", "sd_stroke_unit", "n_usual", "mean_usual", "sd_usual"), drop = FALSE]), , drop = FALSE]
d$study_label <- make.unique(as.character(d$study))
es <- metafor::escalc(measure = "MD", n1i = n_stroke_unit, m1i = mean_stroke_unit, sd1i = sd_stroke_unit, n2i = n_usual, m2i = mean_usual, sd2i = sd_usual, data = d, slab = study_label)   # yi = effect size, vi = its variance
meta <- metafor::rma(yi, vi, data = es, method = "REML", test = "z", level = 95)
z <- qnorm(1 - (1 - 0.95) / 2)
studies <- data.frame(study = d$study_label, yi = as.numeric(es$yi), se = sqrt(es$vi), weight = as.numeric(weights(meta)))
studies$lower <- studies$yi - z * studies$se
studies$upper <- studies$yi + z * studies$se
pooled <- predict(meta)   # pooled estimate with confidence and prediction interval
# Egger's regression test for funnel plot asymmetry
egger <- metafor::regtest(meta, model = "lm", predictor = "sei")
forest_df <- data.frame(term = c(studies$study, "Pooled"), est = c(studies$yi, pooled$pred),
                        lower = c(studies$lower, pooled$ci.lb), upper = c(studies$upper, pooled$ci.ub), weight = c(studies$weight, 100))
forest_df$term <- factor(forest_df$term, levels = rev(forest_df$term))
# Names are drawn inside the panel, left of the data (ggnext clips long axis labels)
label_pad <- min(0.5, (max(nchar(as.character(forest_df$term))) * 7 + 12) / 500)
forest_df$label_x <- min(forest_df$lower) - (max(forest_df$upper) - min(forest_df$lower)) * label_pad / (1 - label_pad)
p_forest <- ggnext(forest_df, aes(est, term, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, size = weight)) +
  geom_forest(ref = 0) +
  geom_text(aes(x = label_x, y = term, label = term), anchor = "start") +
  labs(title = "Forest plot", x = "Mean difference (95% CI)") +
  theme(axis_title_y = FALSE, axis_text_y = FALSE, legend_position = "none", base = theme_modern())
se_max <- max(studies$se) * 1.05
funnel_lines <- data.frame(x = pooled$pred, y = 0, xend = pooled$pred + c(-1, 1) * z * se_max, yend = se_max)
p_funnel <- ggnext(studies, aes(yi, se)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), data = funnel_lines) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = pooled$pred, dash = "4 4") +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(title = "Funnel plot", x = "Mean difference", y = "Standard error") +
  theme_modern()
